decisions.reason: Adding supplied proposal tables does not alter the separate requirement to include all supplied narrative content.
The source independently specifies incorporation of the organization chart, which is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY; table inclusion requires no further change.
Incorporating supplied tables does not necessarily change or cancel the existing page-count target.
Photo incorporation is a separate parallel requirement established by the same source, not a consequence of the table-integration change.
The decision to incorporate supplied tables does not alter the specified GreenLatinos branding state.
Table incorporation is compatible with the existing full-document layout requirement and does not require changing any of its attributes.
Including supplied tables does not change the independent requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
